tasks.name: reconcile-stuck-purchases
tasks.description: Every 5 minutes, scan for stuck pack purchases and retry fulfillment if the song now exists

tasks.name: backfill-song-creators
tasks.description: One-shot: backfill creator wallet on songs where it is null/empty, resolved from users collection via songDetails.artistEmail

tasks.name: prune-processed-signatures
tasks.description: Weekly (Monday midnight UTC): delete processedSolSignatures entries older than 90 days to keep the anti-replay audit log bounded

tasks.name: expire-apple-pay-reservations
tasks.description: Every 30 minutes: expire Apple Pay checkout reservations older than 45 minutes to free daily budget headroom for abandoned checkouts
